_comment: Generated by `task generate:agent-digests` at release prep. Maps each published agent to the immutable image digest a release pulls instead of the floating `latest` tag, so a release's sandbox is reproducible and cannot drift when the freshness watcher (#1088) republishes images. An empty `images` map means no agent is pinned yet and releases keep pulling `latest` (the pre-#1233 behavior). Do not hand-edit; regenerate. See docs/development/sandbox-agent-images.md.
